origin.description: List the character encodings ICU knows.

arguments.name: simplify
arguments.text: TRUE returns every alias once. Any other value returns a list of aliases by canonical name.

origin.details: Only a length-one TRUE simplifies. Names are sorted with the en_US primary collator and numeric ordering. Duplicates are removed after that sort's source order, keeping the first spelling.
origin.value: A character vector, or a named list of character vectors.
origin.example:
x <- stri_enc_list()
cat(paste0("stri_enc_list() returns ", length(x), " encoding names.\n"))

translation.description: List the character encodings ICU knows.

arguments.name: simplify
arguments.text: True returns every alias once. Any other value returns a dict of aliases by canonical name.

translation.details: Only a real True simplifies. The string "TRUE", FALSE, NA, and None do not. Names are sorted with the en_US primary collator and numeric ordering. The function returns the full list.
translation.value: A list of strings, or a dict of canonical name to alias list.
translation.example:
from stringi.encoding import stri_enc_list
x = stri_enc_list()
print(f"stri_enc_list() returns {len(x)} encoding names.")
